category.description: dApps: app, defi, staking, rwa, nft, game, virtual-world, governance, bridge. Tools: wallet, explorer, analytics. For operators (listed on a separate page): monitoring, developer-tools, infrastructure.

description.description: One or two sentences, from the project's own material.

appUrl.description: The product itself, not its marketing page.

links.description: Optional: the project's website, docs and socials.

network.description: Optional: set only for an app that runs on a testnet.

chains.description: Only in shared/<id>/: two or more Explorer chain slugs from chains.json. A listing under chains/<chain>/ takes its chain from the folder and has no chains field.

coverPosition.description: Optional: CSS object-position for the 16:9 crop of the cover.

explorer.description: Set by Kynraze during review, not by the author: a link from the card into an Explorer page.

topic.description: Required for analytics, e.g. staking or districts.
